card.name: Psychology citations and references
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside psychology journal citations and reference lists, such as author names, Psychol Bull, and the start of an abstract. It responds at points where the citation continues.

modes.label: Journal citation details
modes.description: Punctuation, spaces and journal-name pieces in a PubMed-style psychology citation followed by the abstract.
modes.example: Roberts BW, Walton KE, Viechtbauer W in<< Psych>>ol Bull. 2006

modes.label: APA-style reference list
modes.description: Linking marks and initials in author lists and titles of psychology references.

card.writes: It pushes toward psychology and APA-related words, such as psych and psychologists.
card.plain: It marks text that sits inside a psychology paper's citation or reference list.
